description.value:
Trigger A creature moves at least 10 feet into the room

Effect A transparent, hard-light barrier springs up across the lapidarium entrance. The barrier allows organic material to enter the area but not exit until the southernmost lattice is deactivated. The lattice on the west wall flares with light, and the hazard rolls initiative.

A grid generated by a lattice on one side of the room moves 30 feet to the opposite side, striking everything in its path. Contact with the grid inflicts @Damage[16d8[force]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|dc:41|basic] save. A character who makes a successful @Check[perception|dc:39] check to [[/act seek]] after observing at least one Sweep notices that a 10-foot gap momentarily appears in each grid just before it reaches the pillar in the center of the room, making the two spaces adjacent to the pillar and facing toward the active lattice safe from each Sweep.

stealth.details: (master) to recognize the chamber as a deadly magical trap

details.description: The crystal lattices on the walls activate in turn, each projecting a hard-light grid of uniform, 6-inch-wide cells. The glowing grids then briskly sweep across the chamber in sequence, dicing organic matter they touch into precise cubes.
details.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) or @Check[arcana|dc:37] (expert) to physically or magically sabotage one of the lattices. Deactivating or destroying all four lattices deactivates the hazard.
details.reset: The trap resets immediately once no living creatures occupy the lapidarium.
details.routine: (2 actions) On each of the hazard's actions, a grid sweeps across the lapidarium in the following repeating sequence: west, north, east, south. A lattice that has been deactivated continues to use one of the trap's actions when its turn in the sequence is reached, but it no longer generates a grid.
